<function name="GetKeyCode" parent="input" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Gets the button code from a button name. This is opposite of <page>input.GetKeyName</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="button" type="string">The internal button name, such as <key>E</key> or <key>SHIFT</key>.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number{BUTTON_CODE}">The button code, see <page>Enums/BUTTON_CODE</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
